title: Murder Mystery Detective Experience in Decatur GA
includes: Walking game map via mobile app (downtown)
Driving game map via mobile app (outskirts)
Live GPS map with turn by turn directions
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Need to provide their own headphones / earbuds (for Walking maps)
Should have a charged mobile device
Transportation between locations is not provided
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into the shoes of a newly-minted detective, tasked by Commander Mahoney to solve a gripping case... murder on the streets of Decatur.

Throughout this crime-solving audio adventure, visit each of the 10 mapped locations. You'll have the option to explore the downtown area using the Walking Map or follow a Driving Map on the city's outskirts. Refer to ‘Meeting Point’ for the starting location. See images for route.

Park or stop at each location, listen to the audio story, and put your detective skills to the test by gathering clues and piecing together the evidence. Finally, make your deductions and issue an arrest warrant. 

Your overall detective skills will be evaluated, culminating in a Case Performance Score to measure your sleuthing prowess. This game is suitable for solo detectives, dynamic duos, or groups of mystery enthusiasts, offering an immersive audio tale filled with intrigue.
